question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
WITH top2 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.db_year,
        col.pcf_violation_category,
        COUNT(*) as cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM collisions col
    JOIN case_ids c ON col.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE col.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL 
      AND col.pcf_violation_category != ''
    GROUP BY c.db_year, col.pcf_violation_category
    QUALIFY rn <= 2
)
SELECT db_year, STRING_AGG(pcf_violation_category, ', ' ORDER BY cnt DESC) as top2_causes
FROM top2
GROUP BY db_year
ORDER BY db_year
